# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" on the left, with "Welcome - user - Visual Studio Code" centered.
- **System Date and Time**: "Oct 23 02:09" is displayed in the center of the header.
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the right side of the header, including:
  - Network/Connection icon
  - Sound/volume control icon
  - Power button icon
- **Window Control Buttons**: Three buttons on the far right of the header:
  - Minimize button (dash icon)
  - Maximize button (square icon)
  - Close button (X icon)

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: A horizontal menu bar with the following items from left to right:
  - File
  - Edit
  - Selection
  - View
  - Go
  - Run
  - Terminal
  - Help

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Icons (Top to Bottom)**:
  - **File Explorer Icon**: A folder icon, currently active.
  - **Search Icon**: A magnifying glass icon.
  - **Source Control Icon**: A branching icon.
  - **Debug Icon**: A bug icon.
  - **Extensions Icon**: A square grid icon.
  - **Terminal Icon**: A terminal window icon.
  - **Settings Icon**: A gear icon.
  - **User Icon**: A person icon.
  - **Grid Icon**: A 3x3 grid icon (application launcher).

## Explorer Panel

- **Panel Title**: "EXPLORER" is displayed at the top.
- **Folder Structure**:
  - **USER Folder**: Expanded, showing subfolders and files.
  - Subfolders:
    - .cache
    - .config
    - .gnupg
    - .ipython
    - .local
    - .mozilla
    - .pki
    - .ssh
    - .thunderbird
    - .var
    - .vscode
    - Desktop
    - Documents
    - Downloads
    - Music
    - Pictures
    - project
    - Public
    - server
    - snap
    - Templates
    - Videos
  - Files:
    - .bash_history
    - .bash_logout
    - .bashrc
    - .lesshst
    - .profile
    - .selected_editor
    - .sudo_as_admin_successful
    - .viminfo
    - requirement.txt

## Main Editor Area

- **Active Tab**: "Welcome" tab is active, with a close button (X) on the right.
- **Welcome Page Content**:
  - **Title**: "Visual Studio Code"
  - **Subtitle**: "Editing evolved"
  - **Start Section**:
    - New File...
    - Open File...
    - Open Folder
    - Connect to...
  - **Recent Section**:
    - project
  - **Walkthroughs Section**:
    - "Getting Started with VS Code"
    - "The Fundamentals"

## Trust Folder Dialog

- **Dialog Title**: "Do you trust the authors of the files in this folder?"
- **Icon**: A blue shield icon with a keyhole.
- **Description Text**:
  - "Code provides features that may automatically execute files in this folder."
  - "If you don't trust the authors of these files, we recommend to continue in restricted mode as the files may be malicious. See our docs to learn more."
- **Path Display**: "/home/user"
- **Checkbox**:
  - "Trust the authors of all files in the parent folder 'home'"
- **Action Buttons**:
  - "No, I don't trust the authors" (gray button, labeled "Browse folder in restricted mode")
  - "Yes, I trust the authors" (blue button, labeled "Trust folder and enable all features")

## Bottom Panel

- **Status Bar**:
  - **Left Side**:
    - "Show welcome page on startup" checkbox, checked.
  - **Right Side**:
    - "Screen Reader Optimized" label.
    - Accessibility icon (screen reader icon).

## Additional UI Elements

- **Activity Bar**: Located on the left side of the window, containing icons for various functions.
- **Explorer Panel**: Located on the left side of the window, displaying the file system structure.
- **Main Editor Area**: Located in the center of the window, displaying the welcome page and trust dialog.
- **Status Bar**: Located at the bottom of the window, displaying status information and options.
